company_description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. provides electronic design and test solutions worldwide. The company operates through Communications Solutions Group and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group segments. It offers electronic design and test software, instrumentation, systems, and related services used in the design, simulation, validation, manufacturing, installation, and optimization of communication systems in wireless, data center ecosystem, enterprise, and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The company also develops and deploys communications products and services; and operates communications networks. In addition, it provides electronic design, test and simulation software, instrumentation, systems, computer-aided engineering solutions, and related services used in the design, simulation, validation, manufacturing, installation, and optimization of electronic equipment in the automotive and energy, semiconductor solutions, and general electronics industries. Further, the company offers product support; technical and application support for hardware, software, and solutions; and professional services, such as installation, training, engineering, optimization of equipment

risks.title: Tariffs and trade tensions
risks.summary: Tariffs and trade tensions materially impact Keysight's costs and revenues. The company has implemented a multi-pronged mitigation strategy but remains exposed to regulatory changes.
risks.score_rationale: The company is directly exposed to U.S. tariffs imposed since Q2 2025, with Chinese retaliatory measures. Material impact on FY2025 results partially mitigated by mitigation strategy (global sourcing, pricing, cost reduction). Dedicated MD&A and mention in forward-looking risks.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.summary: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations affect revenues, costs, and monetary assets. Keysight uses a short-term hedging program but remains exposed in the long term.
risks.score_rationale: Company operates globally (40,000 customers in 100+ countries). Short-term hedging program (12 months) on revenues, costs, and balance sheet. Structural long-term exposure. Detailed MD&A on Currency Exchange Rate Exposure.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and customer demand
risks.summary: Inflation, potential recession, financial volatility, and tighter credit conditions may reduce R&D investments from Keysight's customer base and affect its revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements list: inflation, potential recession, financial market volatility, reduced credit access, interest rate changes. Customer sectors sensitive to economic cycles (aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics). Customer R&D demand depends on macro conditions.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.summary: Recent acquisitions (Spirent, Synopsys OSG, Ansys PowerArtist) generate significant integration costs and associated operational risks, partially offset by revenue growth.
risks.score_rationale: Three acquisitions in FY2025: Spirent ($1,415M, $9M incremental revenue), Synopsys OSG ($578M), Ansys PowerArtist ($26M). High acquisition and integration costs in 2025, cited as a net income drag. Integration risk is real but acquisitions are strategic.

risks.title: Competition and pricing pressure
risks.summary: Intense competition in test and design solutions may pressure margins and prices, affecting profitability despite revenue growth.
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive test and design market. Gross margin declined (62.1% vs 62.9% prior year), partly due to tariff impact but also product/service mix. Implicit pricing pressure in competitive environment. 8% revenue growth but margin at 5-year lows.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and export controls
risks.summary: Tightening export control regulations, especially for critical technologies, may restrict Keysight's sales in certain markets and sectors.
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements mention 'tightening of export control regulations'. Company operates in regulated sectors (defense, aerospace, government, telecommunications). Risk of restricted access to sensitive markets or customers.

ai_positioning.summary: Keysight does not directly commercialize AI products but positions its test and design solutions as enablers for customers investing in AI. The company states that customers are expected to continue R&D investments in AI and related technologies, including AI, industrial IoT, 5G/6G, and autonomous vehicles.
evidence: Outlook section: 'Our customers are expected to continue to make R&D investments in certain next-generation technologies and applications, including evolution of 5G, early 6G, high-speed data center networks and infrastructure, satellite networks, artificial intelligence (AI), industrial internet of things (IoT), defense modernization, and next generation electric vehicles and autonomous vehicles.'
